info.title: BuiltBlock Account API
info.description: Read one customer, the customer book, or resolve a name or domain to an account id. Push one item, or set lifecycle and customer_since. Use an API key from the API page in BuiltBlock.

apiKey.description: API key from the API page in BuiltBlock. Send it as Authorization: Bearer, or as x-api-key.

Usage.description: Full weekly windows for each usage metric in your catalog. Null when no observations exist. Keys are metric ids from your catalog, not a fixed product list.

description.description: Explanation of this metric for this organization.

UsageCatalog.description: Tenant metric definitions. Descriptions are what summaries and risk read.

description.description: Explanation of this metric for this organization.

BookRowUsage.description: 30-day current value and change for each usage metric in your catalog. Full windows stay on GET /v1/accounts/{id}/state.

current.description: Sum of 30d current across the book

change.description: Sum of 30d change across the book

BookUsage.description: 30-day usage rollup. Change groups each account by its net 30-day change. Metric keys come from your usage catalog.

current.description: Sum of 30d current across the book

change.description: Sum of 30d change across the book

outcomes.description: Standing outcomes on this account. Sibling of use_cases. A use case is not nested here.

use_cases.description: Standing jobs on this account. Sibling of outcomes. outcome_id is set only when this job supports an outcome on the same account.

outcome_id.description: Outcome id on this account, or null when this job has no parent

usage.description: Full weekly windows for each usage metric in your catalog. Null when no observations exist. Keys are metric ids from your catalog, not a fixed product list.

usage_catalog.description: Tenant metric definitions. Descriptions are what summaries and risk read.

description.description: Explanation of this metric for this organization.

firmographics.description: Create-time company snapshot. Null when no profile row exists. ARR on account stays the CRM deal number.

usage.description: 30-day current value and change for each usage metric in your catalog. Full windows stay on GET /v1/accounts/{id}/state.

truncated.description: True when the row list is capped at 500

usage.description: 30-day usage rollup. Change groups each account by its net 30-day change. Metric keys come from your usage catalog.

current.description: Sum of 30d current across the book

change.description: Sum of 30d change across the book

usage.description: 30-day current value and change for each usage metric in your catalog. Full windows stay on GET /v1/accounts/{id}/state.

account.description: Optional. Name or domain creates or attaches. Id attaches to an existing account.

customer_since.description: ISO date the account became a customer. A date-only value is UTC midnight.

person.description: Optional. Email, LinkedIn, or name is enough. A work email can place the account.

kind.description: What this object is. unknown lets BuiltBlock decide.

description.description: What this object is, in your own words.

source_id.description: A custom id you invent to identify this object in your system. The same id retries the same write.

PartnerAccountUpdate.description: Set lifecycle, customer_since, or both. A HubSpot lifecycle or a won deal still decides the book.

relationship.description: The relationship the book will use after this write.

lifecycle_applied.description: False when a HubSpot lifecycle or a won deal kept the existing lifecycle.

post.description: Create or attach a company and optional person, then enqueue the item on ingest. Account and person are each optional. source_id is a custom id you invent.

400.description: Need an account or a person, or the item is invalid

get.description: Full-book counts plus up to 500 short customer rows. usage is a 30-day rollup (change buckets plus catalog metric totals). Each row carries 30d current and change only. Full windows stay on GET /v1/accounts/{id}/state.

patch.description: Mark an existing account customer, prospect, former, or unknown, and record when they became a customer. Enqueues diagnosis. A HubSpot lifecycle or a won deal still wins.

200.description: Facts stored. relationship is what the book will use.

400.description: Need a lifecycle or a customer_since

get.summary: Resolve name or domain to an account id

400.description: Need exactly one of name or domain

get.description: Full customer projection: account, log, diagnosis, summary, outcomes, use cases, people, timeline, and usage windows when they exist.
